source_clause: C20.) MAX DEFROST: On vehicles with MAX DEF, MAX DEF replaces FRONT DEF button. MAX DEF automatically turns on A/C, changes airflow modes to Windshield, increases fan speed to highest setting (7/7), sets temperature (driver and passenger if available) at highest setting (HI), change RECIRC to open (LED off), turns on Sync and activates the REAR DEFROST. MAX DEF switches off automatically after a set time after which the system goes back to the previous manual mode. Change in fan speed does not break MAX DEF. Changing temperature, recirculation, mode distribution or pressing again MAX DEF breaks MAX DEF (turns MAX DEF off) and the system goes back to the previous manual mode with the A/C on. Pressing A/C breaks MAX DEF (turns MAX DEF off) and the system goes back to the previous manual mode with the A/C off. Pressing AUTO brakes MAX DEF (turns MAX DEF off) and the system goes to AUTO. Similarly, pressing MAX A/C turns MAX DEF off (turns MAX DEF off) and the system goes to MAX A/C.
reasoning: 驗證目標：3.2（C20）定義 MAX DEF 之取代關係、開啟時之連動設定、自動關閉，以及六種「破壞／不破壞」之區別，八個 037 leaf 逐一對應，故一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：配置軸取 profile §3.2 第五軸「MAX DEF 有無」，其 R-C28 第一問由條文首句「On vehicles with MAX DEF」明文對應，標 spec-verbatim；-06 另需第四軸「MAX A/C 有無」，其第一問由「Similarly, pressing MAX A/C turns MAX DEF off」一句推得該功能存在，標 spec-derived。為什麼這樣切：§8.2.2 之壓力測試對 -02（七項連動）與 -07（四個破壞來源）逐一施加，兩者之部分失效皆可定位到具編號之 ER 行，故以列舉式步驟保持 procedure／ER 1:1 而不拆條 —— 拆條會產生 spec 未區分之 TC，反向合併多 leaf 為一條則自始禁止。刻意略過：「switches off automatically after a set time」條文未給數值，故 -03 之步驟以可觀察量（MAX DEF 不再作用）為終止條件，不寫入任何秒數（R-C22 ／ §8.4.1）；A/C、AUTO、溫度等基本控制非配置軸，不寫入 pre_conditions（profile §3.2 禁「Climate is available」型隱含前提）。

tcs.tc_title: MAX DEF replaces the FRONT DEF button
tcs.test_item: On vehicles with MAX DEF, MAX DEF shall replace the FRONT DEF button
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Read the front defrost control label on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is displayed
2. The "MAX DEF" button is shown in place of the "FRONT DEF" button
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: MAX DEF sets seven climate states when turned on
tcs.test_item: MAX DEF shall automatically turn on A/C, change airflow modes to Windshield, increase fan speed to the highest setting (7/7), set the temperature (driver and passenger if available) at the highest setting (HI), change RECIRC to open (LED off), turn on Sync and activate the REAR DEFROST
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen with MAX DEF not active
2. Press "MAX DEF"
3. Read the A/C state
4. Read the airflow mode
5. Read the fan speed
6. Read the temperature setting for the driver and, if available, the passenger
7. Read the RECIRC state and its LED
8. Read the Sync state
9. Read the REAR DEFROST state
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "MAX DEF" button is not active
2. The "MAX DEF" button is active
3. A/C is on
4. The airflow mode is Windshield
5. The fan speed is at the highest setting (7/7)
6. The temperature is at the highest setting (HI) for the driver and, if available, the passenger
7. RECIRC is open and its LED is off
8. Sync is on
9. REAR DEFROST is active
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: MAX DEF switches off automatically and restores the manual mode
tcs.test_item: MAX DEF shall switch off automatically after a set time, after which the system shall go back to the previous manual mode
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the climate system to a manual mode with a known airflow mode, fan speed and temperature setting
2. Press "MAX DEF"
3. Leave the climate controls untouched until the "MAX DEF" button is no longer active
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the airflow mode, fan speed and temperature setting that were set
2. The "MAX DEF" button is active
3. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and the airflow mode, fan speed and temperature setting are those of the previous manual mode

tcs.tc_title: Pressing A/C breaks MAX DEF and leaves A/C off
tcs.test_item: Pressing A/C shall break MAX DEF, turning MAX DEF off, and the system shall go back to the previous manual mode with the A/C off
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the climate system to a manual mode with a known airflow mode, fan speed and temperature setting
2. Press "MAX DEF"
3. Press "A/C"
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the airflow mode, fan speed and temperature setting that were set
2. The "MAX DEF" button is active
3. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active, the airflow mode, fan speed and temperature setting are those of the previous manual mode, and A/C is off

tcs.tc_title: Pressing AUTO breaks MAX DEF and enters AUTO
tcs.test_item: Pressing AUTO shall break MAX DEF, turning MAX DEF off, and the system shall go to AUTO
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "MAX DEF" button is active
2. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and the climate system is in AUTO

tcs.tc_title: Pressing MAX A/C breaks MAX DEF and enters MAX A/C
tcs.test_item: Pressing MAX A/C shall turn MAX DEF off, and the system shall go to MAX A/C
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with MAX A/C (3.2)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "MAX DEF" button is active
2. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and MAX A/C is active

tcs.tc_title: Temperature, RECIRC, mode and MAX DEF again each break MAX DEF
tcs.test_item: Changing temperature, recirculation or mode distribution, or pressing MAX DEF again, shall break MAX DEF, turning MAX DEF off, and the system shall go back to the previous manual mode with the A/C on
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "MAX DEF"
2. Change the temperature setting
3. Press "MAX DEF"
4. Change RECIRC
5. Press "MAX DEF"
6. Change the mode distribution
7. Press "MAX DEF"
8. Press "MAX DEF" again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "MAX DEF" button is active
2. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and the system is in the previous manual mode with A/C on
3. The "MAX DEF" button is active
4. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and the system is in the previous manual mode with A/C on
5. The "MAX DEF" button is active
6. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and the system is in the previous manual mode with A/C on
7. The "MAX DEF" button is active
8. The "MAX DEF" button is no longer active and the system is in the previous manual mode with A/C on

tcs.tc_title: A fan speed change does not break MAX DEF
tcs.test_item: A change in fan speed shall not break MAX DEF
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "MAX DEF"
2. Change the fan speed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "MAX DEF" button is active
2. The fan speed changes and the "MAX DEF" button is still active
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
